c40.note: Loans held for investment $462.5B at Sept 30, 2026.

c60.note: Page shows $196.71 at 1:31 PM EST on Nov 11, 2026, not $196.29; intraday price is also transient.

c18.note: Capital One's About page says it serves 'more than 100 million customers across a diverse set of businesses'. The statement is undated but current. Both variants E and A match the page wording.

c27.note: The 2025 10-K says 'We were the largest issuer of credit cards in the U.S. based on the outstanding balance of credit card loans as of December 31, 2025.' The fact is tied to a year-end date, so it is not dated within 90 days of 2026-11-11.

c21.note: Capital One's company page says Fairbank has been CEO since the November 1994 IPO and Chairman and CEO since February 1995.

c31.note: The FY2025 10-K describes the Discover Network, PULSE Network and Diners Club as the Global Payment Network, with Network Partners as card issuers on it. The Credit Card segment includes personal loans.
